name: Reduce diagnostic data (telemetry)
description: Sets diagnostic data to the minimum your edition allows, stops the Connected User Experiences service and disables the compatibility-appraiser and CEIP data collection tasks.
sideEffects: Windows Insider builds require optional diagnostic data. Home/Pro treat 0 as "Required only".

name: Disable Activity History
description: Stops Windows from collecting and uploading a timeline of the apps, files and sites you use.

name: Disable advertising ID
description: Turns off the per-user advertising ID apps use for personalized ads (same switch as Settings > Privacy > General).

name: Disable tailored experiences
description: Stops Microsoft using your diagnostic data to show personalized tips, ads and recommendations.

name: Block auto-installed promoted apps
description: Prevents Windows from silently installing promoted apps and games (Candy Crush, TikTok, etc.) for new users.

name: Disable suggestions, tips and "suggested content"
description: Turns off suggested apps in Start, tips and tricks notifications, the post-update welcome experience and suggested content in Settings.

name: Disable lock screen fun facts and tips
description: Removes the "fun facts, tips, tricks and more" overlay and ads from the lock screen. Spotlight wallpaper itself keeps working.

name: Disable Bing web results in Start search
description: Start menu search only searches your PC and apps, not the web. Faster and more private.
sideEffects: Web answers no longer appear in Start search.

name: Disable inking & typing personalization
description: Stops Windows building a personal dictionary from what you type and write.
sideEffects: Handwriting recognition and text suggestions may be slightly less accurate.

name: Disable location services
description: Denies location access system-wide (Settings > Privacy > Location).
sideEffects: Find My Device, Maps, Weather auto-location and automatic time zone stop working.

name: Block device companion app auto-downloads
description: Stops Windows fetching device metadata and OEM companion apps (e.g. vendor control panels) when you plug in hardware.

name: Disable firmware-injected software (WPBT)
description: Blocks the Windows Platform Binary Table, which lets motherboard firmware silently install vendor software (e.g. Armoury Crate) on every clean install.
sideEffects: Some OEM anti-theft tools (Absolute/Computrace) rely on WPBT.

name: Disable Recall snapshots
description: Prevents Recall from saving screenshots of your activity (Copilot+ PCs).

name: Disable Click to Do
description: Turns off the Click to Do AI overlay (Win + click) on Copilot+ PCs.

name: Disable Windows Copilot
description: Turns off the legacy Copilot sidebar and hides the Copilot taskbar button. On 24H2+ Copilot is a normal app - remove it on the Debloat page.

name: Disable AI features in Notepad and Paint
description: Turns off Copilot/Rewrite in Notepad and Cocreator, Image Creator and Generative Fill in Paint.

name: Stop Chrome downloading on-device AI models
description: Prevents Google Chrome from downloading its multi-GB local Gemini Nano model.
sideEffects: Chrome on-device AI features (Help me write, etc.) will be unavailable. Chrome shows "managed by your organization".

name: Disable Edge Copilot sidebar
description: Removes the Copilot/Discover sidebar from Microsoft Edge.
sideEffects: Edge shows "managed by your organization".

name: Set rarely used auto-start services to Manual
description: A short, conservative list (Maps broker, Edge/Google/Adobe updaters, link tracking, compatibility assistant) switched from Automatic to Manual so they start only when needed. Nothing is disabled and every original value is journaled.
sideEffects: None expected. Unlike some tools, Rigwright never touches update, security or Store services.

name: Visual effects: best performance (keep smooth fonts)
description: Turns off animations, fades, shadows and Aero Peek while keeping font smoothing and thumbnails. Noticeable on older or low-power PCs.
sideEffects: Windows looks flatter. Sign out and back in for every effect to apply.

name: Add and activate the Ultimate Performance power plan
description: Unlocks the hidden Ultimate Performance plan and makes it active. Best for desktops; on laptops it costs battery life.
sideEffects: Higher idle power use and heat.
undoScript:
$p = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\powercfg.exe"
& $p /setactive 381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e
foreach ($l in ((& $p /list) | Select-String 'Ultimate Performance')) { $g = ([regex]::Match($l.Line, '[0-9a-f\-]{36}')).Value; if ($g) { & $p /delete $g } }
'Switched back to Balanced and removed Ultimate Performance.'

name: Never sleep or turn off the display (all power plans)
description: Sets display-off, sleep, hibernate, disk-off, lock-screen display-off and unattended-sleep timeouts to Never on plugged-in and battery, for every power plan.
sideEffects: Laptops on battery will drain faster. Closing the lid or pressing the power button still follows their own settings.
undoScript:
$p = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\powercfg.exe"
& $p /change monitor-timeout-ac 10; & $p /change monitor-timeout-dc 5
& $p /change standby-timeout-ac 30; & $p /change standby-timeout-dc 15
& $p /change disk-timeout-ac 20; & $p /change disk-timeout-dc 10
'Restored Windows default timeouts on the active plan (display 10/5 min, sleep 30/15 min).'
detect: ((& "$env:SystemRoot\System32\powercfg.exe" /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_SLEEP STANDBYIDLE) -match "Current AC Power Setting Index: 0x00000000").Count -gt 0 -and ((& "$env:SystemRoot\System32\powercfg.exe" /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_VIDEO VIDEOIDLE) -match "Current AC Power Setting Index: 0x00000000").Count -gt 0

name: Disable hibernation
description: Turns hibernation off and deletes hiberfil.sys, freeing disk space equal to a large part of your RAM.
sideEffects: Also disables Fast Startup. Laptops can no longer hibernate on low battery.

name: Stop Store apps running in the background
description: Prevents Microsoft Store apps from running in the background when you are not using them.
sideEffects: Store apps (Mail, Phone Link, some chat apps) may not show notifications until opened.

name: Remove startup app delay
description: Windows waits about 10 seconds after sign-in before launching startup apps. This removes that artificial delay.

name: Disable Windows Search indexing
description: Stops the search indexer service. Reduces background disk and CPU use on slow drives.
sideEffects: Start/File Explorer search becomes slower and Outlook desktop search may stop working.

name: Download updates from Microsoft only (no P2P)
description: Stops your PC uploading Windows updates to other PCs on the internet (Delivery Optimization set to HTTP only).

name: Throttle Delivery Optimization in the background
description: Caps Delivery Optimization (Windows Update and Microsoft Store downloads) at 5% of your bandwidth for background downloads and 50% for downloads you start yourself, so updates stop hogging the connection while you work or game.
sideEffects: Updates and Store apps download more slowly. The caps apply to downloads from Microsoft servers and internet peers, not from PCs on your local network. Settings > Windows Update > Advanced options > Delivery Optimization shows the limits as managed by your organization. Windows no longer offers a documented upload cap (DOMaxUploadBandwidth is deprecated); pair this with "Download updates from Microsoft only" to stop uploads entirely.

name: Enable Storage Sense
description: Lets Windows automatically clear temporary files and empty the Recycle Bin of old items when space runs low.

name: Run Storage Sense weekly
description: Turns Storage Sense on and schedules it to run every week instead of only when disk space runs low, deleting temporary files that apps are no longer using. Your Downloads folder is never touched.
sideEffects: Temporary files are removed once a week. The Recycle Bin keeps whatever Storage Sense setting it already has (Windows default: items older than 30 days are emptied when Storage Sense runs). Review the schedule under Settings > System > Storage > Storage Sense.

name: Disable automatic folder type discovery
description: Stops Explorer guessing the folder type (Pictures, Music...) on every open, which makes large folders load much faster.

name: Enable Game Mode
description: Lets Windows prioritize the game you are playing and pause Windows Update installs while you play.

name: Disable background game recording (Game DVR)
description: Turns off background capture, which costs a few FPS on weaker GPUs.
sideEffects: Xbox Game Bar "Record that" and background clips stop working. The Game Bar overlay itself still opens.

name: Enable hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
description: Lets the GPU manage its own memory scheduling. Usually lowers latency on modern NVIDIA/AMD GPUs; required for DLSS Frame Generation.
sideEffects: Rarely causes stutter with old drivers - undo if so.

name: Enable optimizations for windowed games
description: Uses the modern flip presentation model for DirectX 10/11 games running windowed or borderless, lowering latency and enabling Auto HDR/VRR.

name: Disable mouse acceleration
description: Turns off "Enhance pointer precision" so mouse movement is 1:1 - preferred for aiming in games.

name: Disable multimedia network throttling
description: Removes the network throttling Windows applies while audio/video plays. Benefit is small and hardware-dependent; included because it is harmless.

name: Dark mode
description: Switches Windows and apps to the dark theme.

name: Disable Windows Spotlight desktop background
description: Stops Windows Spotlight rotating Bing wallpapers on the desktop and fetching new images and captions from Microsoft in the background.
sideEffects: The "Windows spotlight" choice in Settings > Personalization > Background becomes unavailable. The current Spotlight wallpaper may stay until you pick another picture or theme. The lock screen is not affected.

name: Show file extensions
description: Shows ".exe", ".pdf" and so on. Important for spotting disguised malware like "invoice.pdf.exe".

name: Show hidden files
description: Shows hidden files and folders such as AppData.

name: Open File Explorer to This PC
description: File Explorer opens to your drives instead of Home/Quick access.

name: Hide Home and Gallery in Explorer
description: Removes the Home and Gallery entries from the File Explorer navigation pane (per user, fully reversible).

name: Hide the "Learn about this picture" desktop icon
description: Removes the "Learn about this picture" icon that Windows Spotlight places on the desktop, while keeping the rotating Spotlight wallpapers.
sideEffects: You can no longer right-click the icon to switch to the next picture or open the image in Bing. Windows may put the icon back if you switch away from Windows spotlight and back again.

name: Classic right-click menu
description: Restores the full Windows 10 style context menu, so you do not need "Show more options".
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name '(default)' -Value ''
'Classic context menu enabled'

name: Add "End task" to taskbar right-click
description: Right-click any app on the taskbar to force-close it without Task Manager.

name: Align taskbar to the left
description: Moves the Start button and app icons to the left like Windows 10.

name: Hide Task View button
description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar (Win+Tab still works).

name: Search box: icon only
description: Replaces the wide taskbar search box with a compact icon.

name: Disable Widgets (news and weather)
description: Removes the Widgets board and its taskbar button, which loads news feeds in the background.

name: Remove Start menu promotions and account nags
description: Turns off "Recommended" tips/app promotions and Microsoft account notifications in Start. Your recent files stay.

name: Show seconds in the taskbar clock
description: Adds seconds to the clock in the system tray.

name: Verbose sign-in / shutdown messages
description: Shows what Windows is doing during startup, sign-in and shutdown - helpful when it hangs.

name: NumLock on at boot
description: Turns NumLock on at the sign-in screen.

name: Disable the Sticky Keys shortcut prompt
description: Stops the Sticky Keys dialog popping up when you press Shift five times (common in games).

name: Enable long file paths
description: Allows paths longer than 260 characters - avoids errors with deep node_modules, git repos and archives.

name: Show details on blue screens
description: Shows the driver and parameters on a blue screen instead of only a sad face.

name: Hardware clock in UTC (dual boot with Linux)
description: Stops the clock jumping by hours when you dual boot Windows and Linux.
sideEffects: Only use this if you dual boot.

name: Daily automatic registry backup
description: Re-enables the RegIdleBackup task Microsoft turned off in Windows 10 1803, so C:\Windows\System32\config\RegBack is kept current.

name: Prevent automatic BitLocker device encryption
description: Stops Windows silently encrypting the drive on setup/sign-in with a Microsoft account. Does NOT decrypt an already-encrypted drive.
sideEffects: Your data is not encrypted if the PC is stolen. Turn BitLocker on manually if you want encryption with a recovery key you control.

name: Legacy F8 boot recovery menu
description: Lets you press F8 at boot to reach Safe Mode and recovery options.
sideEffects: Adds a short delay at boot.

name: Disable Connected Devices Platform service
description: Stops the Connected Devices Platform (CDPSvc and the per-user CDPUserSvc), which keeps a background connection to Microsoft for cross-device features such as Nearby sharing, Phone Link and the shared clipboard.
sideEffects: Nearby sharing, Phone Link, clipboard sync across devices, "Continue on PC" and some Bluetooth and Project/Cast features stop working, and their Settings pages may show errors. Undo and reboot to get them back.

name: Block potentially unwanted apps (Defender PUA)
description: Makes Microsoft Defender block adware, bundleware and crypto miners, not just viruses.

name: Disable AutoRun/AutoPlay for all drives
description: Stops USB sticks and discs running anything automatically when inserted.

name: Disable SMBv1 (insecure file sharing protocol)
description: Turns off the 1980s SMB1 protocol abused by WannaCry. Only very old NAS devices need it.
script: Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Set-SmbServerConfiguration -EnableSMB1Protocol $false -Force; "SMB1 disabled"

name: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
description: Keeps IPv6 enabled but makes Windows try IPv4 first. Fixes slow connections on networks with broken IPv6. (Safer than disabling IPv6, which breaks some VPNs.)

name: Updates: delay feature updates 1 year, quality 4 days
description: Still installs security fixes promptly but holds big feature upgrades for 365 days so others find the bugs first. Windows Update and its repair service stay fully enabled.
sideEffects: Pro/Enterprise/Education only - Home ignores deferral policies. Settings shows "Some settings are managed by your organization".

name: Stay on your current Windows version
description: Pins this PC to its current version (e.g. 24H2) - monthly security updates continue, but no feature upgrade until you undo this.
sideEffects: Remember to undo before your version reaches end of support. Settings shows "managed by your organization".
script:
$cv = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion'
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate'
New-Item $k -Force | Out-Null
$prod = 'Windows 10'; if ([int]$cv.CurrentBuild -ge 22000) { $prod = 'Windows 11' }
Set-ItemProperty $k -Name TargetReleaseVersion -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty $k -Name TargetReleaseVersionInfo -Value $cv.DisplayVersion -Type String
Set-ItemProperty $k -Name ProductVersion -Value $prod -Type String
"Pinned to $prod $($cv.DisplayVersion)"

name: Do not install drivers through Windows Update
description: Stops Windows Update replacing your GPU/chipset drivers with older generic ones.
sideEffects: You must update drivers yourself (vendor tools or Device Manager).

name: No automatic restart while you are signed in
description: Windows waits for you to restart instead of rebooting while you are signed in.

name: Pause updates for 5 weeks
description: The same as Settings > Windows Update > Pause, for the maximum 35 days. Undo resumes updates.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings'
$now = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime(); $end = $now.AddDays(35)
$f = 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'
New-Item $k -Force | Out-Null
foreach ($n in 'PauseFeatureUpdatesStartTime','PauseQualityUpdatesStartTime','PauseUpdatesStartTime') { Set-ItemProperty $k -Name $n -Value $now.ToString($f) }
foreach ($n in 'PauseFeatureUpdatesEndTime','PauseQualityUpdatesEndTime','PauseUpdatesExpiryTime') { Set-ItemProperty $k -Name $n -Value $end.ToString($f) }
"Updates paused until $($end.ToLocalTime())"

name: Edge: remove shopping, rewards, sidebar and tracking
description: Turns off Edge shopping assistant, Rewards, sidebar, startup boost, background running, personalized news feed and diagnostic data.
sideEffects: Edge shows "Your browser is managed by your organization".

name: Uninstall OneDrive
description: Uninstalls the OneDrive client. Your files in the cloud are not deleted.
sideEffects: Make sure everything is synced first. Files that existed "online-only" are no longer reachable from this PC. If Desktop/Documents were redirected to OneDrive, move them back first.
